topics.label: Introduction and Overview of Cancer Hallmarks
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic introduces the lecture by framing the learning outcomes, connecting to previous lectures, and outlining the hallmarks of cancer framework.

topics.label: Sustained Proliferative Signaling and Evasion of Growth Suppressors
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics explain how oncogenic mutations in receptor tyrosine kinase, Wnt/APC, and TGF-beta signaling pathways drive autonomous cell proliferation and survival.

topics.label: Differentiation Block in Cancer
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics demonstrate how cancer cells arrest terminal differentiation while continuing to proliferate, using hematological malignancies and colorectal crypt architecture as examples.

topics.label: Resistance to Apoptosis
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic details how cancer cells evade programmed cell death through mutations in p53 and dysregulation of pro- and anti-apoptotic Bcl-2 family proteins.

topics.label: Replicative Immortality and Senescence Signaling
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics explain how cancer cells achieve replicative immortality by overcoming telomere-driven senescence and p53 stress responses, concluding the survey of cell-intrinsic growth-control hallmarks.

topics.label: Cancer Metabolism and the Warburg Effect
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics examine how cancer cells rewire their metabolism toward aerobic glycolysis and how Krebs cycle mutations generate oncometabolites that alter the epigenome.

topics.label: Tumor Angiogenesis
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics explain the requirement of angiogenesis for tumor growth, its early induction during progression, and the balance of regulatory signals controlling blood vessel formation.

topics.label: Invasion and Metastasis
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic examines the biological cascade, diagnostic monitoring, and genomic characteristics associated with cancer cell dissemination and metastasis.

topics.label: Closing Remarks and Summary
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic concludes the lecture with framing on the evolution of cancer hallmark frameworks, learning outcomes review, and practicals housekeeping.
